V1018|⚡⚡⚡**A NOISE FLOOR ! BE RELATIVE TO THE *DECLARED SCALE*, ⊥ TO THE *VALUE* — RELATIVE-TO-VALUE PRESERVES CATASTROPHIC-CANCELLATION RESIDUE & TELLS THE SAME LIE ∈ THE OTHER DIRECTION.** measured (§T997), & it is the assertion its author would point a reviewer at first. the row asked for one constant to be split into two, & the obvious split — *round to N SIGNIFICANT DIGITS of the value* — **REGRESSES**: a Rotate field (−360…360, derived step 7.2) fine-dragged BACK THROUGH ITS OWN START lands on **`-7.105427357601002e-15`**. ⚑**AN ABSOLUTE CAP FLATTENED THAT TO 0; RELATIVE-TO-VALUE *KEEPS* IT, & "ROTATION IS ZERO" THEN BECOMES FALSE ∈ A DOCUMENT WHERE THE USER PUT THE VALUE BACK.** ∴ the fix is relative **TO THE PARAMETER'S OWN DECLARED RANGE**: 1e-11 of the scale the author stated. ⛑**THE GENERAL RULE: "RELATIVE" IS ⊥ ONE CHOICE — *RELATIVE TO WHAT* IS THE WHOLE DECISION, & THE VALUE ITSELF IS THE WRONG REFERENT WHENEVER THE VALUE CAN BE THE RESIDUE OF A CANCELLATION.** a quantity near zero carries the LEAST information about its own precision, which is exactly when a value-relative tolerance trusts it most. ⛑**& THE SHAPE-FOLLOWS-JOB TEST THAT SETTLED THE PAIR: LEGIBILITY IS ABSOLUTE (a human reads a field @ a fixed size) & NOISE IS RELATIVE (a float's error scales w/ its magnitude) ∴ ONE CONSTANT COULD ⊥ HAVE SERVED BOTH *EVEN AT THE RIGHT NUMBER* — they do ⊥ have the same SHAPE.** §V832's two-jobs-one-number, w/ the reason the collapse was impossible rather than merely unwise.
V1019|⚡⚡⚡**AN INSTRUMENT THAT READS ZERO FROM A *VALID* SUBJECT IS INVALID FOR THAT SUBJECT — ⊥ EVIDENCE OF ABSENCE. & AN INSTRUMENT THAT CANNOT SEE THE FAILURE *MODE* IS ⊥ EVIDENCE EITHER.** measured (§T1329b), & the author recorded BOTH rather than dressing either up. hunting a suspected mid-drag BLANK ∈ the preview canvases: **(1) a `drawImage` pixel probe READ 0 LIT PIXELS FROM EVERY WebGPU CANVAS *WHILE THE TILES WERE VISIBLY RENDERING*** ∴ the probe is **INVALID FOR A WebGPU SURFACE** (its contents are ⊥ reachable that way), & its zero says NOTHING about blanking. **(2) FRAME-GAP TIMING CANNOT DETECT A CLEARED FRAME — A BLANK FRAME STILL PRESENTS ON TIME.** the metric is orthogonal to the hypothesis & would read HEALTHY through the entire defect. ⚑**BOTH ARE §V968'S KNOWN-POSITIVE RULE ARRIVING BEFORE THE MEASUREMENT RATHER THAN AFTER: THE QUESTION IS ⊥ "DID MY DETECTOR FIRE" BUT "*CAN THIS INSTRUMENT PHYSICALLY OBSERVE THE THING I AM LOOKING FOR*" — & FOR A ZERO, THE DIFFERENCE BETWEEN "⊥ THERE" & "⊥ VISIBLE TO THIS TOOL" IS THE WHOLE ANSWER.** ⛑**THE HONEST OUTPUT IS A *⊥ CONFIRMED*, ⊥ A NULL: the row now records the blank as UNVERIFIED & names WHY NEITHER INSTRUMENT COULD SETTLE IT.** ⛑**COMPANION, SAME PASS: AN ASYMMETRY CAN BE AN ARTEFACT OF THE TEST'S OWN SETUP.** the first run showed bottom & right degrading & left clean — **because bottom & right were ALREADY @ THEIR LIMITS FROM EARLIER DRAGS & BARELY RESIZED.** the author nearly reported *"all three identical, hypothesis dead"*, **& it was NEITHER: the churn follows WHICHEVER EDGE ACTUALLY MOVES. A SEQUENCE OF GESTURES ∈ ONE SESSION LEAVES STATE, & THE SECOND MEASUREMENT IS TAKEN ON THE FIRST ONE'S LEFTOVERS.**
V1020|⚡⚡⚡**A DOCUMENTED DECISION'S *REASONING* IS OFTEN NARROWER THAN ITS APPARENT *SCOPE* — READ THE ARGUMENT BEFORE DECIDING WHETHER YOU ARE EVEN CONTRADICTING IT.** measured (§T1342b): the row was filed as *"was the §V90 call right, & does §T1337b change the answer?"* w/ two outcomes costed — vindicate it, ∨ overturn it. **BOTH WERE WRONG, & READING §V90's OWN TEXT IS WHAT SHOWED IT.** §V90 was BELIEVED to argue *"prose belongs ∈ a `title=`"*. **IT ARGUES NO SUCH THING: it makes a LAYOUT claim (a `?` handle wrapped onto its own line ∈ a two-column grid) & a REDUNDANCY claim (an indicator for something the label already implies), BOTH ABOUT THE PARAMETER ROW.** ∴ **A SURFACE REACHED FROM THE *HEADER* CONTRADICTS NEITHER, & THE ROW'S WHOLE VINDICATE-OR-OVERTURN FRAME WAS A FALSE DICHOTOMY BUILT ON AN UNREAD ARGUMENT.** ⚑**THE FAILURE MODE IS EXPENSIVE ∈ BOTH DIRECTIONS: overturning it would have RE-LITIGATED STILL-CORRECT REASONING @ EVERY ROW; deferring to it would have LEFT 115 NODE DESCRIPTIONS UNREACHABLE ON THE AUTHORITY OF AN ARGUMENT THAT NEVER MENTIONED THEM.** ⛑**∴ WHEN A ROW PROPOSES OVERTURNING A DOCUMENTED DECISION, THE FIRST STEP IS ⊥ TO WEIGH IT — IT IS TO *READ IT & STATE WHAT IT ACTUALLY CLAIMS*. A DECISION'S TITLE IS A SUMMARY; ITS ARGUMENT IS THE CONTRACT** (§V989/§V994's shape — a name is ⊥ evidence of what a thing does — applied to a *decision* rather than to code). ⛑**COMPANION FINDING, SAME PASS: A DESTINATION CAN BE ADDRESSABLE ∈ PRINCIPLE & UNADDRESSABLE FROM OUTSIDE.** the help panel's nodes tab HAS a search; `ui.openHelp`'s input is a four-value SECTION enum ∴ **no caller can ask for a node, & the gap is ∈ THE COMMAND'S INPUT TYPE rather than ∈ the surface.** §V998's two-halves shape one layer up: **the display works, the input vocabulary cannot express the request.**
V1021|⚡⚡**ASSERT THE *TAG*, ⊥ THE CLICK: A `<span>` W/ A HANDLER PASSES A MOUSE TEST & FAILS A USER.** measured (§T1342b): making the inspector's type badge activatable, the claim asserts that the element IS a `<button>` — ⊥ that clicking it fires. ⚑**A CLICK HANDLER ON A NON-INTERACTIVE ELEMENT SATISFIES EVERY `fireEvent.click` EVER WRITTEN & IS UNREACHABLE BY KEYBOARD, INVISIBLE TO ASSISTIVE TECHNOLOGY, & CARRIES NO FOCUS RING.** the test that exercises the MECHANISM cannot distinguish the working control from the broken one; only the test that asserts the CONTRACT can. **§V-testing-bar's "assert what the CONSUMER reads back, ⊥ the mechanism" — where the consumer is A PERSON W/ A KEYBOARD & what they read back is THE ELEMENT'S OWN ROLE.** ⛑**& THE COROLLARY THAT DECIDED THE DESIGN: INTERACTIVITY IS ⊥ FREE & ITS COST IS PAID WHERE THE AFFORDANCE IS ⊥. a shared badge made focusable EVERYWHERE puts a TAB STOP on every node type ∈ the library & every graph tile — so the capability is OPT-IN PER CALL SITE, & the default stays the inert element it has always been.**
V1022|⚡⚡**A VERDICT ARM NO REAL HOST CAN PRODUCE ! A BROWSER SUITE WOULD PASS COMPLETELY W/ THAT BRANCH DELETED.** the coverage went against a FAKE `HostFacts` RECORD, which is the only instrument that can construct the state. ⛑**THE GENERAL RULE: AFTER BUILDING A MULTI-VALUED DECISION, ASK OF *EACH* VALUE — "WHAT REAL INPUT PRODUCES THIS?" A VALUE W/ NO PRODUCER ∈ REACH OF YOUR HARNESS IS ⊥ DEAD CODE (it may fire on a user's machine tomorrow) & ⊥ COVERED. IT NEEDS A CONSTRUCTED FIXTURE, & THE FIXTURE IS THE ONLY EVIDENCE THE BRANCH WORKS.** ⛑**THIS IS WHY §T1341b's EVALUATOR BEING *PURE* WAS LOAD-BEARING RATHER THAN TIDY: a verdict function that took the real host could ⊥ have been tested here at all.**
V1023|⚡⚡⚡**MEASURE A FEATURE ∈ THE STATE WHERE IT ACTUALLY DOES SOMETHING — A VALID INSTRUMENT ∈ A CONDITION THAT MAKES THE FEATURE *INERT* REPORTS A TRUE NULL ABOUT NOTHING.** measured (§T1334b), & the author VOIDED THEIR OWN EARLIER ARMS ON FINDING IT. viewport culling was first profiled @ **`fitView`** — the obvious, reproducible, apparently-neutral starting state — & **@ fitView ALL 77 NODES ARE INSIDE THE VIEWPORT ∴ THE FLAG CULLS NOTHING & THE TWO CONFIGURATIONS ARE THE SAME PROGRAM.** the deltas were real noise correctly measured; they were simply **A/A ARMS WEARING AN A/B LABEL.** ⚑**THE TRAP IS THAT THE CHOSEN STATE WAS CHOSEN FOR GOOD REASONS — CANONICAL, REPRODUCIBLE, EASY TO SCRIPT — & THOSE REASONS ARE UNCORRELATED W/ WHETHER THE FEATURE IS *ENGAGED* ∈ IT. A DEFAULT VIEW IS EXACTLY THE STATE MOST LIKELY TO BE PICKED & ⊥ MOST LIKELY TO EXERCISE.** ⛑**THE CHECK IS ONE CHEAP COUNTER & ! COME BEFORE THE TIMINGS: *MEASURE THAT THE FEATURE CHANGED SOMETHING* — here, MOUNTED NODE COUNT (77 → 16). a gap between arms is meaningless until the arms are DIFFERENT PROGRAMS.** §V968's known-positive rule aimed @ the CONDITION rather than @ the detector: **before trusting an A/B, PROVE THE B IS A B.** ⛑**& THE HONEST OUTPUT IS A *SCOPED* RESULT, ⊥ A HEADLINE: "8–12× less layout WHILE ZOOMED IN, NOTHING @ FIT VIEW" is the finding. A FEATURE THAT HELPS ∈ THE SHAPE A USER *WORKS* ∈ & ⊥ ∈ THE SHAPE THEY *OPEN* ∈ IS STILL WORTH SHIPPING — BUT SHIPPING IT W/ AN UNSCOPED NUMBER IS HOW THE NEXT PROFILE 'FAILS TO REPRODUCE' IT.**
V1024|⚡⚡⚡**THE RUN THAT CONFIRMS YOUR HYPOTHESIS IS THE ONE THAT MOST NEEDS REPEATING — & A FIX CAN BE CORRECT, MEASURED & STRUCTURAL WITHOUT BEING EVIDENCE THAT THE REPORTED SYMPTOM IS CURED.** measured (§T1329b). **(1) THE OUTLIER: one early control run read MEDIAN 69 ms w/ 40 FRAMES OVER 32 ms — exactly the jank the row was chasing — & it DID ⊥ SURVIVE REPETITION. five later production runs read 8–10 ms & ZERO long frames.** the author reported it **as an outlier rather than as the finding they wanted**, & that is the whole discipline: **a result that agrees w/ you ends the investigation, so it is the one whose repetition you are least inclined to run & most obliged to.** ⛑**(2) THE WITHDRAWAL: the row's own diagnosis figures (20–30 ms medians, 7–10 long frames) were the DEV build & were retracted BY THEIR AUTHOR when the production arms disagreed** (§V1010). **A NUMBER ALREADY WRITTEN INTO A ROW IS ⊥ THEREBY EVIDENCE; IT CARRIES WHATEVER CONDITIONS IT WAS TAKEN UNDER, & IT ! BE WITHDRAWN OUT LOUD WHEN THEY TURN OUT TO MATTER.** ⛑**(3) THE HONEST CLOSE: the fix removes 80 per-gesture backing-store writes → 2, which is MEASURED & STRUCTURAL — & the owner's reported jank DID ⊥ REPRODUCE on the developer's production build @ dpr 1 ∨ 2. ∴ THE ROW CLOSES ON MECHANISM & THE CURE IS *UNCONFIRMED*.** ⚠**THE TEMPTATION IS TO CLOSE IT ON THE MECHANISM & LET THE READER INFER THE CURE. DO ⊥: A ROW THAT CLAIMS MORE THAN IT MEASURED IS HOW THE *NEXT* REPORT OF THE SAME SYMPTOM GETS DISMISSED AS ALREADY-FIXED.** the missing measurement is on the REPORTER'S machine, & asking them is a step ∈ the work rather than an admission.
V1025|**A FED BUFFER IS WRITTEN ONLY BY ITS SOURCE.** a plan `buffer` w/ `sourceId` takes `MediaSourceFrame.bytes` from offset 0 when — & only when — the source's frameId advances ∨ a clear zeroed it (the cursor resets w/ the bytes, T773's pairing); a payload larger than the buffer ∨ ⊥ a multiple of 4 is REFUSED BY NAME & ⊥ written (a truncated vertex list is a plausible wrong shape); the cursor rides a carried buffer (a mesh ⊥ re-uploads on an unrelated edit). a consumer reads an unfed buffer as NOTHING — an all-zero index list is degenerate triangles, never a shape|T1353b,V135,V136
V1026|**A NODE CARD'S SOCKETS ARE ITS DECLARED PORTS — A VALUE BAG'S CHANNELS NEVER BECOME SOCKETS, & NO PER-FRAME UI SCALES WITH CHANNEL COUNT UNCAPPED.** measured (§B228): 1124 channel socket rows & 1198 bar rows on E32's 77 nodes put the main thread at 100% & the app at 20–25 fps; with both removed, HEAD is back at baseline. channel choice lives ∈ a Select node ∨ a channel-picker parameter (§T1390b). any per-channel view on a card is capped & visibility-gated.
V1028|**A LAYER ⊥ IMPORTS THE LAYER THAT IMPORTS IT, & EVERY PLAIN-NODE ENTRY POINT — & EVERY MODULE UNDER `src/domain`, `src/compiler`, `src/runtime` — IMPORTS CLEANLY AS THE FIRST MODULE OF A FRESH `node`.** a value read at module scope across an import cycle is uninitialised whenever the far side loads first, & vitest ⊥ sees it ∵ a test file loads other modules first (§B246). held by lint `v1028/layering-zone` (`parameters ↛ presets`, `parameters ↛ components`, `domain ↛ ui/editor/react`, `cue-list.ts ↛ commands`, `morph.ts ↛ graph/registry/resolver`; type-only imports included ∵ `import { type X }` still loads the module; tests exempt), by `first-import.test.ts` ∈ `test:gates` (entry points DERIVED from package.json/CLAUDE.md/docs/docblocks + `src/projects/*/{render,build}.ts`; a script is ⊥ evaluated whole, its import list is replayed), & by `first-import-all.test.ts` (`pnpm test:first-import`, the three layers, 249 modules). open: `domain ↛ compiler` is false today (§T1594b)|B246,V901,V957
V1027|**IN REALTIME A PLAYING MEDIA ELEMENT IS ITS OWN CLOCK: THE PLAYHEAD FOLLOWS THE ELEMENT, ⊥ THE ELEMENT THE PLAYHEAD.** ∀ realtime frame of continuous free-run playback: `element.playbackRate === speed` EXACTLY & 0 `currentTime` writes. a clock disagreement is paid by the picture & the readouts (drop a frame, re-base the accumulator), ⊥ by samples — §T740's principle, extended from the timeline to the media layer. before the first gesture (the shared AudioContext suspended, §T1548b) a routed element is held muted and the playhead runs on the frame clock, adopting the element once the context runs; rate & no-write rules hold throughout. the element is written ONLY on a DELIBERATE discontinuity (cue, scrub, lap, trim ∨ speed edit, mode change, resume). **a hidden tab is ⊥ a discontinuity** (owner 2026-10-03): the element plays on, is ⊥ paused & ⊥ sought on return — the playhead steps to it. **a gate ! assert the RATE & the HEARD seconds** (element advance ≡ wall × speed across an injected stall) — "zero seeks" & a ±5% rate band are mechanism & were green while the audio ran off real time (§B236). the timeline lock is ⊥ covered here: there the frame stays master (§V436), with the stepped correction of §T1549b.
V1029|Generated text depends on what a node IS, not how many items the document contains. Author-controlled counts (lights, projectors, casters, inputs, layers, strips, attributes) are DATA in buffers/texture arrays/uniforms or counted plan-loop regions; N and 2N produce byte-identical text. EXCEPTIONS each require a ledger with bound/reason: (a) definition-fixed counts; (b) language-required per-item declarations (texture bindings, schema members/accessors), only declarations/independent statements, with named refusal at a stated count (a byte limit implying a count qualifies); (c) per-item passes reusing shared text; (d) a value-carrying chain only under named refusal at ≤8 items AND a measured linear-cost record with a reference pass beside every frame (Composite’s fold is the known case). Never an unbounded per-item function body carrying one value across the chain. `generated-text-growth.test.ts` derives registry count axes and checks 1,2,4,16; chain exemptions in NOT_YET_DATA carry task IDs/exact lengths that can only decrease. Additional non-growth laws: LITERAL replaces one compile-time value without growing text, bounded by the parameter maximum; BRANCH uses one text for one and another for several, identical thereafter (`pointTopology.sheets`). The cure belongs to the app’s core, not a single patch’s shader trick. [Full original contract, decisions and evidence](SPEC-ARCHIVE.md#archive-2026-10-09-v1029).|B260,T1635b
V1030|**A SHIPPED EXAMPLE MAY SHIP A LAYER OFF; §V25'S NO-DEAD-NODES GATE HOLDS IT TO THE PLAN WITH ITS OFF LAYERS ON.** (owner 2026-10-22, superseding the rule that refused any Layer shipped off, which made E82 ship idle layers ON at opacity 0 and made off-by-default looks cook.) `runner.test.ts`: with every off Layer on (`runExample().layersOn`, `compileLayerWarmPlan`), nothing but the unwireable is pruned; the shipped plan prunes exactly that plus what the off Layers hide, and an off Layer is spliced out of `order`. An off look is not dead weight: a reader sees the Layer's off switch. A chain dead even with the layer on still fails (§T1718b).
V1035|**BYPASS IS WIRES, PAIRED PER PORT BY KIND & POSITION; MUTE IS NOTHING; ONE FUNCTION, EVERY SEAM (§B301, owner 2026-11-12: *"definitely need to figure out the bypass, that's essential loom core that needs to work"*).** a BYPASSED node is replaced by wires: output k of a kind passes input k of THAT kind, unchanged (`bypassPassthroughPairs`, `src/domain/graph/bypass.ts`; for a node's first output this is §V305's rule, the only question while every node had one output). an output w/ ⊥ partner (more outputs of a kind than inputs, ∨ ⊥ input of the kind) passes ⊥ & reads DISCONNECTED, as a bypassed source does; a node that pairs ⊥ at all is silenced, & says so when it has inputs (`compiler/bypass-incoherent`). a MUTED node produces ⊥ on every output, & muted wins over bypassed. ∀ seam that carries a wire reads the ONE function: the compiler's splice (textures, pointsets) & the value graph's topology (a bypassed node that is ⊥ a value member — an un-inlined instance, §T1032 — is followed back to the member that publishes). a per-node answer (*first input → every output*) is the defect: it handed a pointset consumer a texture. gate: `src/tests/integration/bypass-matrix.test.ts`, one cell per node class × port shape × {live, bypassed, muted, wire cut}
V1038|**THE PROJECT TEMPO REACHES A FRAME ONLY AS `FrameEvaluationInput.tempo`, STAMPED BY THE TRANSPORT; OFFLINE IT IS THE DOCUMENT BPM ALONG THE FRAME'S ABSOLUTE TIME (§T1785b; §V44's rule for the beat).** taps, MIDI pulses & audio claims happen on the wall clock; ONE object (`ProjectTempo`, built by the composition root, handed its clock) turns them into one reading per frame, & a transport stamps it (`TempoReader`). no node definition, expression ∨ value stage reads a clock ∨ the tempo object for it: they read the frame (`tempoOf`, `scopeFromFrame`). an offline transport stamps `documentTempo(settings)`, so a render's beats are a function of (frame, document) & nothing else; a stepped / rendered frame on the live clock moves the beat by its own step, ⊥ the wall. the BPM & source are document state (`ProjectSettings`), the phase is session state. gates: `project-tempo.test.ts` (§V1038 block: two offline runs equal; a stepped take ignores a lurching wall clock; an unstamped transport reads the default).
V891|⚑⚑**ONE OPERATOR CANNOT BOTH CONNECT & ISOLATE — & a file whose elegance is *one matrix, two quantities* buys that elegance by GIVING UP INDEPENDENT CONTROL OF THE TWO.** §T1079 measured it twice ∈ one example: **a cross-community bond IS a colour path** ∴ every setting that makes bridges visible makes the hues converge, down to weights BELOW the background tie; & **`reach` weights one operator read twice** ∴ every gain that stirs the layout stirs the colour identically. ⚑the general form, & it is the COST of the property that makes such an example worth having: **when 2 quantities ride ONE operator, every knob is a knob on BOTH, & a requirement that they behave DIFFERENTLY is a requirement for a SECOND operator.** ∴ before demanding *X moves & Y holds*, ask whether X & Y share their weight — if they do, the ask is ⊥ a tuning problem & ⊥ amount of range-widening reaches it. & the honest resolutions are only 3: **accept the coupling, split the operator, ∨ change the INPUT they share** (§T1079's density finding is the third)|V865,V884,T1022,T1070,T1079

TRAVEL W/ ITS SOURCE — IF A CALLER *CAN* RE-DERIVE IT, ONE EVENTUALLY WILL, & WRONGLY.** §T1066: `runExample` returned `document` & `components` while the COMPONENT-AWARE node view stayed inside; the oracle re-derived a bare registry & **severed every component instance ∈ the plan w/o throwing.** the fix is ⊥ *remember to pass the registry* — it is that **the runner now HANDS BACK the aware view beside the components: SPLITTING THAT PAIR *IS* THE BUG.** ⚑& the reason it went unnoticed for so long is the aggravating half: **A DEGRADED COMPILE IS ⊥ A FAILED ONE.** `unknown-node-type` is a DIAGNOSTIC, the edge severs as endpoint-missing, & the result is a VALID EMPTY PLAN — so every downstream assertion runs happily against a black rectangle. ∴ ∀ harness that compiles: **ASSERT THE DIAGNOSTIC SET IS EMPTY & THE PASS COUNT IS NON-ZERO** before asserting anything about pixels — a plan that compiled is ⊥ the same as a plan that compiled WHAT YOU MEANT|V844,V854,V877,T1066

## §P COORDINATION

The initial parallel wave/track plan is historical. Its task lists and session incidents are [archived verbatim](SPEC-ARCHIVE.md#archive-2026-10-09-parallel-plan); current task status is in §T, not that schedule.

Preserve other sessions’ work. Agree ownership before touching shared paths; a completed design read means a task is claimed before implementation. Shared-contract changes require coordination before dependent work. Keep transient probes in the scratchpad, outside `src/`. Use `pnpm typecheck`; root references-only `tsc --noEmit` or green Vitest does not prove types, and a shader-source assertion does not prove changed pixels (§V147). Do not commit, checkout, reset, rebase, stash, or otherwise mutate Git state; the current AGENTS.md governs workflow.

Committed directions retained from the old backlog: renderer-in-worker; multi-window perform; audio analysis/WebMIDI as resolver consumers; WebCodecs MP4; components/subgraphs; media nodes; WebMCP/MCP adapters. Verify current tree/§T state before proposing work. Bus adapters/tool schemas remain adapter logic, not a second home for app logic (§V39).

B302|2026-11-12|FIXED (uncommitted, w/ §B301): **THE RENDER HARNESS — & `pnpm render`, which renders through it — COULD NOT COMPILE A DOCUMENT HOLDING A MUTED OR BYPASSED COMPONENT INSTANCE.** Literal: `renderHeadless` on a graph w/ one bypassed instance → `Parity graph failed to compile: compiler/unknown-node-type: "grade1" (component:grade@1): Node "grade" has unknown type "component:grade@1"`. Cause: a flagged instance is not inlined (§T1032) ∴ its node reaches validation as itself, & `render-harness.ts` built its registry from the bare node definitions (`registry(request.nodes)`), where the app & `prepareProject` hand the compiler the component-aware view. ∴ every offline render of a project saved w/ a source rig OFF (the §T1770b selector's normal state) would have stopped there. Fix: `registry(nodes, components)` returns `createComponentAwareRegistry` when the request carries components; all 8 call sites pass them. Found by §B301's own Dawn test, which is its repro (`src/tests/headless/bypass-instance.gpu.test.ts`). RUN: `tools/heavy.sh pnpm render <scratch copy of projects/silk-medusa/silk-medusa.loom.json w/ its Bloom instance bypassed> --at 0 --warmup 0` → `1920x1080 at frame 0 (0.000 s), 30 fps, spp 1, quality live`, exit 0, the picture whole (looked at).
B301|2026-11-12|FIXED (uncommitted; §V1035): **BYPASS ON A COMPONENT INSTANCE MEANT TWO THINGS — A WIRE IN THE TEXTURE COMPILER, SILENCE IN THE VALUE GRAPH — AND IN THE COMPILER EVERY OUTPUT TOOK THE FIRST OUTPUT'S INPUT WHATEVER ITS KIND.** Found as one cell (a bypassed instance with a value input and a value output published nothing to its reader), then the whole matrix was probed through the real flattener, compiler and value graph (`scratchpad/mute/matrix.ts` of the §T1770b session; T/P/V = texture/pointset/value; each consumer reads `srcN` = the source on input N, or nothing). BEFORE, bypassed: plain nodes (all have one output; `render` has six textures) right everywhere: filter passes, source and converter silent. Instances: `[T]→[T]` and `[P]→[P]` pass; **`[V]→[V]` nothing (should be src0)**; **`[T,V]→[T,V]`: T src0, V nothing**; **`[T,V]→[V,T]`: V nothing AND T nothing with `node.compile.missingResource` (the texture consumer was handed the value input's producer; no `bypass-incoherent` said why)**; **`[T,P,V]→[T,P,V]`: T src0, P error `node.points.edge` (handed the texture), V nothing**; **`[T]→[V,T]`: both nothing (whole node muted because the FIRST output had no partner)**; **`[T,T]→[T,T]`: both outputs src0**; `[T]→[T,T]`: both src0; **`[V,V]→[V,V]` and `[V]→[V,V]`: nothing**. Sources `[]→[T|P|V]` and kind mismatches `[T]→[V]`, `[V]→[T]`, `[P]→[T]`: nothing, the last three with `compiler/bypass-incoherent` (right). MUTED: nothing on every output in every cell, both seams (right, unchanged). CAUSES: (1) `splicePassthroughNodes` kept ONE `{input, output}` per bypassed node and rewired every edge leaving it, by any port, to that input's producer; (2) `valueTopology` takes value NODES as members and dropped every edge through an un-inlined instance. FIX: the rule is per port (§V1035, `bypassPassthroughPairs`: output k of a kind ← input k of that kind); the splice keys wires, feeding edges, producers and aliases by (node, port); the value graph's topology follows an edge back through a bypassed non-member to the publishing member (no per-port bags were needed: every value NODE has one output, and the only multi-output carrier of values is an instance, which is never a member). AFTER, bypassed: `[V]→[V]` src0; `[T,V]→[T,V]` src0, src1; `[T,V]→[V,T]` src1, src0; `[T,P,V]→[T,P,V]` src0, src1, src2; `[T]→[V,T]` nothing, src0; `[T,T]→[T,T]` src0, src1; `[T]→[T,T]` src0, nothing; `[V,V]→[V,V]` src0, src1; `[V]→[V,V]` src0, nothing; every other cell as before. CHANGED BEHAVIOUR TO KNOW: a second output of a kind no longer repeats the first input (`render` bypassed passes Environment on `out` only; its depth/normal/albedo/lightDepth/shadow outputs read disconnected, where they used to carry Environment). Both callers of the value graph (`use-value-graph.ts`, the render harness) and the frame-compile fast path reach the same two functions; a bypass flip is a structural revision, so neither keeps a stale topology. Left: the by-name read of a bypassed instance (→ §T1779b).

It IS added and selected; it is not visible. B299|2026-11-08|**A Feedback read OUTSIDE its loop gets this frame's state, not the previous frame's.** Measured on Dawn (probes in the session scratchpad, `t1744b/tap-probe.ts`): a tap reading a counter loop's Feedback reads 1,2,3,4 over frames 0–3, the same as the kernel inside the loop; the node's description ("Outputs the previous frame of its input", `feedback.ts:38`) promises 0,1,2,3. No shipped document reads a Feedback outside its loop (all 17 feedback documents checked). wanted: one contract for every reader, a Feedback read is one step behind its source whatever the plan order; proposed as §V1031 in `docs/feedback-interleaving-and-render-quality-2026-11-08.md` and built with §T1744b once the owner rules the design. B294|2026-10-19|FIXED (harness, not backend): §V8 RUNNER GATE RED ON UNTOUCHED EXAMPLES (E2, E12, E49, E89: createBuffer +1, createBindGroup +N per frame on the mock device). vgpu 0.6.0 captures a frame's managed uniforms into a pooled 64 KiB page returned only when the frame completes (`node_modules/vgpu/dist/frame-uniforms.js` #take/#createPage); `renderTrace` (`src/examples/runner.ts`) rendered frames back to back in one JS turn, so every frame took a fresh page and re-minted the bind groups naming it. §T1707b's commit `3cc42f53` fixed the two sibling gates (`phase1-exit`, `mock-commands`) with a tick per frame and missed this one. V828|Gates enumerate the consumer of the omitted value, not merely the edit classification. Every product caller of `passStructureKey` or `resourceStructureKey` must declare how uniform values reach the GPU without rebuilding. Whenever identity deliberately omits X, each caller explains how X is delivered. [Full original contract, decisions and evidence](SPEC-ARCHIVE.md#archive-2026-10-09-v828).|B176,B118,V5
V829|Scripts spawning background load guarantee cleanup on success, failure and interruption with exit/signal traps, bounded children, or both; killing on the last line is insufficient. Tight shell loops may require SIGKILL. Check orphan processes before measuring load (`ps -Ao pid,ppid,command`): invisible burners contaminate every later measurement. Do not change T780/T781 budgets solely from the historical orphan finding; remeasure first. [Full original contract, decisions and evidence](SPEC-ARCHIVE.md#archive-2026-10-09-v829).|V713,T780,T781
Reviewed integration of #8 and #9 (2026-10-08): seek controls state that temporal history carries; explicit full reset covers GPU and CPU state. Panel captions give way before numeric values. Caption editing follows undo and external changes, and leaving the field cannot reinstate an undone rename. Component instance labels may use the free space up to their nearest row neighbor; ordinary node labels retain their existing clip. #3 remains an unapproved design proposal.
